# Introduction

# Demo


```{r obs data prepare}
predict_log_PL_compute <- function(betahat, 
                                   predbeta, 
                                   X_test, 
                                   Y_test, 
                                   status_test) {
  term1 <- CoxPL(betahat, X_test, rep(0, length(Y_test)), Y_test, status_test)
  term2 <- CoxPL(predbeta, X_test, rep(0, length(Y_test)), Y_test, status_test)

  return(term1-term2)
}

N_rep <- 100
M <- 1000
n <- 100
test_n <- 100

rho <- 0.5
censor_rate <- 0.1
p <- 20
sim_times <- 5

all_result_squareloss_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = sim_times, nc = 4)
all_result_log_pl_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = sim_times, nc = 4)
for (sim in 1:sim_times) {
  cat("\n simt_imes:", sim)
# Generate obs data
X_obs <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), n, p)
X_test <-  matrix(rnorm(test_n * p), test_n, p)
# X_obs<-scale(X_obs)
X_obs[, 1] <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.9)
X_test[,1]<- rbinom(n, 1, 0.9)

X_obs[, 3] <- rchisq(n, 1)
X_test[,3]<- rchisq(n, 1)

X_obs[, 2] <- rchisq(n, 4)
X_test[, 2] <- rchisq(n, 4)

X <- X_obs
beta <- c(4, -4, 3, -3, 1, -1, 1, -1, rep(1, p - 8)) / sqrt(p)

Xbeta <- as.numeric(X %*% beta)
X_testbeta <- as.numeric(X_test %*% beta)

TT <- sapply(1:n, function(i) {
  rexp(1, 0.5 * exp(Xbeta[i]))
})

TT_test <- sapply(1:n, function(i) {
  rexp(1, 0.5 * exp(X_testbeta[i]))
})


if (censor_rate == 0.1) {
  pre_value <- quantile(TT, 0.95)
  pre_value_test <- quantile(TT_test, 0.95)

  C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
  C_test <- runif(test_n, 0, pre_value_test)
  
  censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
  censor_rates_test <- sum(C_test < TT_test) / n
  target_censor_rate <- censor_rate
  target_censor_rate_test <- censor_rate
  while (abs(target_censor_rate - censor_rates) > 0.02) {
    C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
    censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
    # print(censor_rates)
  }
  
  while (abs(target_censor_rate_test - censor_rates) > 0.02) {
    C_test <- runif(test_n, 0, pre_value_test)
    censor_rates <- sum(C_test < TT_test) / test_n
    # print(censor_rates)
  }
}
if (censor_rate == 0.2) {
  pre_value <- quantile(TT, 0.90)

  C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
  censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
  target_censor_rate <- censor_rate
  while (abs(target_censor_rate - censor_rates) > 0.02) {
    C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
    censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
    # print(censor_rates)
  }
}
if (censor_rate == 0.4) {
  pre_value <- quantile(TT, 0.70)

  C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
  censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
  target_censor_rate <- censor_rate
  while (abs(target_censor_rate - censor_rates) > 0.02) {
    C <- runif(n, 0, pre_value)
    censor_rates <- sum(C < TT) / n
    # print(censor_rates)
  }
}

Y_status <- t(sapply(1:n, function(aa) {
  c(min(C[aa], TT[aa]), (C[aa] > TT[aa]))
}))

Y_status_test <- t(sapply(1:n, function(aa) {
  c(min(C_test[aa], TT_test[aa]), (C_test[aa] > TT_test[aa]))
}))

Y <- Y_status[, 1]
Y_test <- Y_status_test[,1]
status <- Y_status[, 2]
status_test <- Y_status_test[, 2]


obs_data <- as.data.frame(cbind(X, Y_status))
colnames(obs_data) <- 1:ncol(obs_data)

data_ <- data_initialization_cox(formula = survival::Surv(`21`, `22`) ~ 1, data = obs_data, syn_size = 1000)

cox_cre_p <- cat_cox(data_=data_, method="CRE", tau=p)
cox_wme_p <- cat_cox(data_=data_, method="WME", tau=p)

cox_cre_cv <- cat_cox_tune(data_=data_, method="CRE", taus=seq(0.5, 50, 0.5))
cox_wme_cv <- cat_cox_tune(data_=data_, method="WME", taus=seq(0.5, 50, 0.5))

all_result_squareloss_matrix[sim, ] <- c(
norm(beta - cox_cre_p$coefficients, "2")^2,
norm(beta - cox_wme_p$coefficients, "2")^2,
norm(beta - cox_cre_cv$coefficients, "2")^2,
norm(beta - cox_wme_cv$coefficients, "2")^2)

all_result_log_pl_matrix[sim, ] <- c(
  predict_log_PL_compute(beta, 
                       cox_cre_p$coefficients, 
                       X_test, 
                                   Y_test, 
                                   status_test),
  predict_log_PL_compute(beta, 
                       cox_wme_p$coefficients, 
                       X_test, 
                                   Y_test, 
                                   status_test),
  predict_log_PL_compute(beta, 
                       cox_cre_cv$coefficients, 
                       X_test, 
                                   Y_test, 
                                   status_test),
  predict_log_PL_compute(beta, 
                       cox_wme_cv$coefficients, 
                       X_test, 
                                   Y_test, 
                                   status_test)
  
  
)

}


```
